script:
control-agent-server api PATCH "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID" --json '{"title": ""}' --expect 422
LONG=$(python3 -c 'print("x" * 201)')
control-agent-server api PATCH "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID" --json "{\"title\": \"$LONG\"}" --expect 422
control-agent-server api PATCH "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID" --json '{"tags": {"Bad-Key": "x"}}' --expect 422
control-agent-server api PATCH <redacted:session-cookie>/not-a-uuid --json '{"title": "QA"}' --expect 422
control-agent-server api PATCH "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID" --json '{"title": "QA"}' --auth none --expect 401
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID" --check title eq 'QA F04 title' --check tags.env eq prod --save F04.patch-errors/get
